summary: Block-list (video) sparse attention in attention.varlen: a data-dependent CSR list of K blocks per q tile, for MiniMax-H3 / FastH3-style learned block selection on SM120/SM121
compatibility: Opt-in. block_sparse defaults to False and the dense path is unchanged (verified bit-identical). New optional keyword arguments on varlen.plan (block_sparse, num_q_tiles, total_blocks_cap) and varlen.bind (block_indices, block_offsets).
details: The sparse walk runs in both the producer (load) and consumer (mma) sides of the warp-specialized contiguous kernel, behind Constexpr[bool] is_block_sparse; the dense/causal/window body is preserved verbatim as the else branch.
The list is authoritative: causal and window constraints are not re-applied, and dense regions (H3 text/audio) are expressed as contiguous runs in the list.
Block size is 64 tokens, matching FastH3 VSA and b12x's existing varlen tile_n=64, so no re-tiling is needed.
Measured at H3 geometry (S=18748, H=56, D=128, RTX 5090 PL 400W): dense 51.611 ms/call vs sparse 5.043 ms/call at 9.6% density = 10.23x.

Correctness gates: a full list reproduces dense exactly; a sparse list matches the fp32 oracle under the same mask; an empty list attends nothing (proving the walk is live, not silently dense); partial final blocks are handled; bind allocates no device memory; the path is CUDA-graph capturable and replays exactly.
